name: Desert Fish Habitat Partnership annual project funding
summary: Annual National Fish Habitat Partnership funding for on-the-ground habitat restoration, barrier work and assessments that conserve native desert fishes in the southwestern US. Typical awards are $5k-$50k.

geography.label: Lower Colorado, Upper Colorado, Rio Grande and Basin and Range regions
